$comment: Surfaces the owner asked for next, with the reason. The mirror image of data/announce-deferred.json: the ledger is rebuilt from the repository on every run and scores a surface only on what it can measure from a description, a route and a directory, so it cannot know that somebody looked at a surface and decided it should go out ahead of its score. A key listed here is sequenced before the rest of the backlog, still inside the slot its own tier owns, so a pin changes the order and never the cadence. `npm run announce:plan` picks it up on the next run. Remove the entry once the surface is packed, since a packed surface leaves the plan anyway.
